exercises.title: Heap sort step by step: the heap after building, then after every extraction
concepts: swap the root to the end
sift down in the shrinking heap
exercises.problemHtml:
Complete static String trace(int[] a): build a max-heap bottom-up (sift down i = n/2−1 … 0; on equal children take the left), append "heap: …"; then for end = n−1 down to 1: swap a[0] and a[end], sift a[0] down inside a[0..end-1], append "step k: …" (k = 1, 2, …). The lines show the whole array (heap part and sorted part together).

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Exactly the textbook steps (the trace depends on them).
  • In place.

Các dòng in cả mảng (phần heap và phần đã sắp cùng lúc).

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: The trace makes the two phases visible: O(n) to build the heap, then n − 1 extractions of O(log n) each. The sorted part grows from the right, one maximum at a time — like selection sort, but the heap finds each maximum in O(log n) instead of O(n).
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Dấu vết làm lộ hai pha: O(n) để dựng heap, rồi n − 1 lần rút, mỗi lần O(log n). Phần đã sắp lớn dần từ bên phải, mỗi lần một giá trị lớn nhất — giống sắp chọn, nhưng heap tìm mỗi giá trị lớn nhất trong O(log n) thay vì O(n).

mistakesJson.loi: Sifting down in the whole array instead of a[0..end−1] — the sorted tail is disturbed.|||Đẩy xuống trong cả mảng thay vì a[0..end−1] — phần đuôi đã sắp bị xáo trộn.

exercises.title: Sort an almost sorted array (each value at most k places away) in O(n log k)
concepts: a sliding min-heap of size k + 1
the minimum of the window is the next value
exercises.problemHtml:
Every value of a is at most k positions away from its place in the sorted order. Complete static void sortNearly(int[] a, int k): keep a min-heap (PriorityQueue) of the next k + 1 values; the minimum of the heap is always the next value of the output. Total O(n log k) — the complexity check uses n = 2,000,000 and k = 10.

⏱ Complexity check. One case runs your code on a large input (n = 2,000,000 with k = 10) inside a 3-second limit. An O(n log k) solution finishes in a fraction of a second on any ordinary laptop; an O(n²) (selection or bubble sort) one needs far longer and the case prints TOO SLOW. The check only rejects quadratic work — the lesson is that knowing k lets you beat a general sort. The limit is generous on purpose — if it fails, the algorithm is the problem, not your machine.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • A heap of at most k + 1 elements; no full sort (rule R1).
  • Write the result back into a.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Mọi giá trị của a lệch tối đa k vị trí so với chỗ của nó khi đã sắp. Hoàn thiện static void sortNearly(int[] a, int k): giữ một min-heap (PriorityQueue) của k + 1 giá trị kế tiếp; phần tử nhỏ nhất trong heap luôn là giá trị tiếp theo của kết quả. Tổng O(n log k) — kiểm độ phức tạp dùng n = 2.000.000 và k = 10.

⏱ Kiểm độ phức tạp. Một ca chạy code của bạn với input LỚN (n = 2,000,000 with k = 10) trong hạn 3 giây. Lời giải O(n log k) xong trong chưa tới một giây trên laptop bình thường; bản O(n²) (selection or bubble sort) cần lâu hơn rất nhiều và ca in TOO SLOW. Phép kiểm chỉ loại công việc bậc hai — bài học là biết k thì vượt được một phép sắp tổng quát. Hạn đặt rộng có chủ ý — trượt ca này thì do thuật toán, không phải do máy bạn.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Each value enters and leaves a heap of at most k + 1 elements: O(n log k). Insertion sort is O(n·k) on such data (also fine for small k); a full sort ignores the structure and pays O(n log n).
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Mỗi giá trị vào và ra một heap tối đa k + 1 phần tử: O(n log k). Sắp chèn trên dữ liệu này là O(n·k) (cũng ổn với k nhỏ); sắp cả mảng bỏ qua cấu trúc và trả O(n log n).

mistakesJson.loi: Polling only when the heap has k elements (not k + 1) — a value can come out too early.|||Lấy ra khi heap mới có k phần tử (không phải k + 1) — một giá trị có thể ra quá sớm.
Forgetting to empty the heap at the end — the last k values are lost.|||Quên lấy hết heap ở cuối — mất k giá trị cuối.

exercises.title: The running median with two heaps
concepts: a max-heap for the lower half, a min-heap for the upper half
exercises.problemHtml:
Values arrive one by one. Complete MedianStream: void add(int x) and double median() — the middle value, or the average of the two middle values when the count is even. Keep the lower half in a max-heap and the upper half in a min-heap with sizes differing by at most one; the median is at their tops.

The complexity check adds 500,000 values and asks for the median after every one: re-sorting each time would be 10¹¹ operations.

⏱ Complexity check. One case runs your code on a large input (n = 500,000 values) inside a 3-second limit. An O(log n) per value solution finishes in a fraction of a second on any ordinary laptop; an O(n log n) or O(n) per value (sorting or inserting into a sorted list) one needs far longer and the case prints TOO SLOW. The limit is generous on purpose — if it fails, the algorithm is the problem, not your machine.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • O(log n) add, O(1) median.
  • median() on an empty stream is never called.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Every value in the lower heap is ≤ every value in the upper heap, and their sizes differ by at most one, so the median is at one or both tops. Each add is a constant number of heap operations: O(log n); the median is O(1).
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Mọi giá trị trong heap dưới ≤ mọi giá trị trong heap trên, và kích thước lệch nhau tối đa một, nên trung vị nằm ở một hoặc cả hai đỉnh. Mỗi lần add là một số hằng thao tác heap: O(log n); median là O(1).

mistakesJson.loi: Adding every value to one heap and copying it to find the middle — O(n) per value.|||Cho mọi giá trị vào một heap rồi chép ra để tìm giữa — O(n) mỗi giá trị.
(low.peek() + high.peek()) / 2 in int — wrong for odd sums and overflows for large values.|||(low.peek() + high.peek()) / 2 bằng int — sai với tổng lẻ và tràn với giá trị lớn.
